items.title: Behind the build: Generative plugins and shaders at Figma
items.excerpt: Rogie King walks through how Figma built generative plugins and shaders, giving designers programmatic and creative control over generated visuals on the canvas — and a way to share what they make with the community.
items.rationale: First-party account of how generation becomes a scriptable, shareable canvas layer — parameters and reuse instead of one-off prompt output.

items.title: Design to Code Tools Benchmark [2026]: 5 Tools, Real Diffs
items.excerpt: The same messy SaaS dashboard was pushed through five design-to-code tools and scored on accessibility, semantics, bundle size, editability, and visual fidelity, with a reproducible harness.
items.rationale: Turns the design-to-code argument into measurable diffs a team can rerun before standardizing on a tool.

items.title: One-Click Line Art From Any 3D Model In Blender
items.excerpt: Masamune Sakaki released a free Blender tool that turns any 3D model into clean line art in a single click, replacing a fiddly Grease Pencil / Freestyle setup.
items.rationale: A free, deterministic 3D-to-2D stylization shortcut with exact control — usable in a pipeline the day it ships.

items.title: Text-to-CAD Isn't Text-to-Mesh: Why the Output Format Is the Whole Story
items.excerpt: A breakdown of why 'AI CAD' demos that emit meshes don't help engineers: without parametric, editable B-rep output, the generated geometry can't be revised or manufactured.
items.rationale: Names the acceptance test for every generative design tool — does it hand back an artifact you can keep editing, or a dead end.

items.title: Empire At Sea Brings A Shared Mixed Reality Drama To Venice Immersive
items.excerpt: Empire At Sea debuts at Venice Immersive as a shared mixed-reality drama where an audience experiences the piece together in one physical space.
items.rationale: Co-located mixed reality is its own design problem — staging, sightlines, shared attention rather than a single solo viewport.
